sections.title: Default setup triggers
items: On push to the default branch or any protected branch.
On pull requests to those branches (not from forks).
Weekly, as long as a push or PR triggered a scan in the last 180 days.
Every 30 days for inactive repos, if an org owner turns that on.
Query suites: `default` or `security-extended` (labelled Extended). Anything else needs advanced setup.

snippets.label: CodeQL advanced setup: the parts the exam asks about
snippets.code:
on:
  push: { branches: [main] }
  pull_request: { branches: [main] }
  schedule: [{ cron: "30 2 * * 1" }]
permissions:
  security-events: write
  contents: read
  actions: read
strategy:
  fail-fast: false
  matrix:
    include:
      - language: javascript-typescript
        build-mode: none
      - language: java-kotlin
        build-mode: autobuild
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v5
  - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
    with:
      languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
      build-mode: ${{ matrix.build-mode }}
      queries: security-extended
  - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4
    with:
      category: "/language:${{ matrix.language }}"

snippets.label: .github/codeql/codeql-config.yml
snippets.code:
name: "Custom CodeQL config"
queries:
  - uses: security-extended
packs:
  - codeql/javascript-queries
query-filters:
  - exclude:
      id: js/unused-local-variable
paths-ignore:
  - docs/**
  - test/**
threat-models: local

snippets.label: CodeQL CLI in another CI system
snippets.code:
codeql database create db --language=javascript --source-root .
codeql database analyze db \
  codeql/javascript-queries:codeql-suites/javascript-security-extended.qls \
  --format=sarif-latest --output=results.sarif
codeql github upload-results --repository=OWNER/REPO \
  --ref=refs/heads/main --commit=$SHA --sarif=results.sarif --sarif-category=cli

`Repository.vulnerabilityAlerts` returns `RepositoryVulnerabilityAlert`; mutation `dismissRepositoryVulnerabilityAlert` with FIX_STARTED, INACCURATE, NOT_USED, NO_BANDWIDTH, TOLERABLE_RISK

sections.title: GitHub Enterprise Server
items: Enable: upload a license that includes the products, then **Management Console > Settings > Security**. Saving restarts services.
Dependabot alerts need **GitHub Connect** and the dependency graph. Dependabot updates need Actions with self-hosted runners.
The CodeQL action ships with GHES. Offline servers update it with `codeql-action-sync-tool`.
Version gates: delegated dismissal 3.17+, Dependabot dismissal delegation 3.21+, malware alerts 3.22+, metered billing through GitHub Connect 3.13+.
GitHub.com only: push protection for users, Dependabot graph jobs.
